change: E017_aorta_huwide plus plan-1.5 augmentation applied to the training slices only: rotation +-15 deg, scale 0.9-1.1, intensity shift +-0.1, no horizontal flip, one geometric transform shared by the image and its GT. Elastic is DISABLED (aug_elastic_alpha 0), a deliberate deviation from the plan-1.5 parameters - E015_augment ran them with elastic_alpha 10 and collapsed the thin trachea (3D Dice 0.377 -> 0.081), and the esophagus is thinner than the trachea and is already the organ E017 under-segments, so repeating an elastic warp would confound this ablation. num_workers is 0 because E015 crashed in the DataLoader with workers=5. Everything else (4-organ target, split, seed, epochs, lr, batch size) is identical to E017.
hypothesis: Augmentation is the standard remedy for a thin structure trained on 15 patients: the esophagus is the organ E017 under-segments (Dice 0.229; predicted/GT volume ratio 0.15-0.60), and the aorta is the largest class so it should be unaffected. Expect esophagus 3D Dice to rise above 0.229 and the train/val gap to narrow, with heart/trachea/aorta held within seed noise (0.900 / 0.664 / 0.667).
plan_reference: AORTA_INSPECTION/aorta-findings.md; full_plan.md section 3 (aorta) superseded for a recoverable label

dataset.name: SEGTHOR_aorta_huwide
dataset.source: segthor_part1 (GT class 1 split back into esophagus + aorta)
dataset.label_caveat: Derived, not annotated: the split is validated by Dice 0.9994/0.9980 against the single reference patient (Patient_07 GT2) and by four geometric gates plus visual review on the other 19.

what_to_check: Esophagus 3D Dice against E017's 0.229 - this is the point of the run. Also check the predicted/GT volume ratio: does it move off 0.15-0.60 toward 1.0?
Aorta 3D Dice against E017's 0.667: augmentation must not cost the new class.
Heart and trachea against E017 (0.900 / 0.664) and E014_hu_wide (0.885 / 0.653): identical labels, so any move beyond ~0.02 is a real effect.
Patient_15, E017's worst case on both organs (esophagus 0.000, aorta 0.537): does augmentation recover any of it?
Train/val gap in dice_tra.npy vs dice_val.npy at the last epoch, against E017's.

comparison_to_parent.protocol: identical data/split/seed/epochs; augmentation is the only changed variable
comparison_to_parent.interpretation: Hypothesis REJECTED on the organ it targeted. Augmentation with elastic disabled raises the aorta (0.724 vs 0.667) and holds heart/trachea, but the thin esophagus gets worse, not better: 3D 0.134 vs 0.229, 2D present-only 0.158 vs 0.266, and the predicted/GT volume ratio falls from 0.15-0.60 to 0.12-0.28. Rotation +-15 deg and scale 0.9-1.1 warp a 5-10 voxel tube; the invariance the model buys costs it exactly the structure it was supposed to recover.
comparison_to_parent.undertraining_caveat: The run is probably undertrained rather than purely worse: augmentation lowers the training 2D Dice to 0.794 at the last epoch against E017's 0.885, and the train/val gap collapses from 0.122 to 0.030. E015's lesson was the same (augmentation needs more epochs; E016 was set to 50). A 50-epoch repeat is the fair test of augmentation on this target, not this 25-epoch run.

notes: Train/val gap: train 0.794 vs val 0.764 at the last epoch (E017: 0.885 vs 0.763). Augmentation does suppress overfitting as intended; 25 epochs is then too short to converge.
Patient_15 remains the worst case for the esophagus (Dice 0.000, 21 % of the target volume) but its aorta improves to 0.590 from E017's 0.537.
Heart 0.905 (+0.005) and trachea 0.661 (-0.003) are inside seed noise on 5 validation patients; the aorta and esophagus moves are not.
Elastic was deliberately disabled (E015 collapsed the thin trachea with it); this run therefore does NOT test the plan-1.5 parameters as written, and says nothing about them.
Heart/trachea comparable with every earlier run; esophagus only with runs on data/SEGTHOR_aorta.
